visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a title card featuring a blue and yellow wavy background. It then cuts to a school corridor where two male students, one with dyed reddish hair and the other with black hair, are in a heated physical argument, pushing each other's chests. A group of students in uniforms watches them in the background under bright natural daylight. (2) The scene shifts to a bathroom with white tiles and mirrors. The two male students are standing inches apart, glaring intensely at each other while continuing their verbal confrontation. The lighting is bright and industrial. (3) In a classroom setting with a green chalkboard, the two students are writing on the board while bumping shoulders aggressively. Other students are visible sitting at green desks in the background. (4) The two boys are then shown leaning across green desks toward each other in a classroom, still arguing. A female student with reddish hair sitting behind them looks irritated and shouts toward them. (5) A transition card titled 'School Cliques' leads into a montage of different student groups in classrooms. One group of boys is shown grabbing each other, followed by separate groups of girls studying, sleeping, and reading novels. Each group is shown reacting aggressively to noise, culminating in a large group of boys making noise in the center of the classroom. The editing pace is fast with frequent cuts.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track starts with high-tempo, energetic electronic background music with a strong percussive beat. Two male voices shout 'Zen yang la' (What?) repeatedly in an aggressive, high-pitched tone, accompanied by audible background crowd murmur. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect marks a transition. The vocal delivery remains rhythmic and loud, with the voices projecting a high-arousal confrontational vibe. The music continues consistently in the background. (3) Percussive thudding sounds of chalk hitting a blackboard are mixed into the shouting male voices. The intensity remains high. (4) A female voice enters the mix, yelling sharply to stop, creating a high-frequency contrast with the male voices. (5) A funky bassline begins. A sequence follows where each segment starts with a percussive impact or slap sound effect, followed by a chorus of multiple voices yelling 'Ke bu ke yi bu yao na me chao a' (Can you not be so noisy?) in a loud, synchronized manner. The video concludes with a massive roar of laughter and cheering from a large group, indicating high energy and comedy.
